Bitfinex took in 135.0 million dollars, Bitstamp took in 129.0 million dollars, and Bybit took in 77.6 million dollars, while Bitget shed 63.3 million dollars. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, so a positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell and a negative print means dollars left those venues.
